test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The Internet is an _________ resource for teachers.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "invaluable"** means extremely useful or indispensable.
 
• In the context of the sentence, it implies that the Internet is a very important resource for teachers.
 
• Other options do not fit the context as well as** "invaluable"** does.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The Internet is an **invaluable** resource for teachers."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **antique** – means old and valuable, typically referring to objects, not fitting here.
 
• **auspicious** – means favorable or promising, not relevant to the context.
 
• **inimical** – means harmful or hostile, opposite of the intended meaning.
